protocol.selector: At each candidate signal, use only hypothetical candidate trades whose exits are strictly before the current signal bar. Maintain a rolling history of up to 100 completed candidate trades per ticker/rule/joint regime. Require at least 30 observations. Score each rule by mean net return after 10 bps per side; require mean > 0 and profit factor > 1.0. Select highest score; deterministic tie-break by PF then rule name. If no rule qualifies, no trade.
protocol.regime: Ticker-specific causal trend-strength and ATR/close volatility ranks; low/mid/high terciles from up to 120 prior observations, at least 60 prior observations, current bar excluded.
protocol.candidate_streams: Six predeclared rules; one non-overlapping hypothetical trade per ticker/rule at a time; next H1 open entry, close after at most 12 H1 bars.
protocol.execution: At most one selected trade per ticker at a time across all rules; no overlapping selected trades. Signal on completed H1 close, entry next H1 open.
protocol.walk_forward: First half of first 80% is warm-up/training only. Remaining first 80% is three chronological evaluation folds. Final 20% is later holdout. Selector state carries forward causally; at each decision only completed prior outcomes are available.
protocol.costs: Selector training threshold uses 10 bps per side (20 bps round-trip). Reported performance uses 5 and 10 bps per side; illustrative only.
protocol.tie_break: Higher rolling mean net return, then higher PF, then alphabetical rule name.

limitations: Diagnostic only: the same historical archive and final 20% have been examined in earlier experiments; this is not an independent confirmatory sample.
Candidate training outcomes are hypothetical per-rule streams and may overlap across rules; selected evaluation trades themselves do not overlap per ticker.
Ticker-specific regimes are not a common MOEX-wide market regime.
Actual spreads, commissions, slippage, short borrow availability/cost, taxes and market impact are not modeled; cost assumptions are illustrative.
Finam H1 bars are technical data; 12 bars do not necessarily equal 12 clock hours.
Pooled trade-chain metrics are diagnostics, not portfolio returns.
Research only: no production, real signals, Telegram notifications, cron changes, secrets or broker orders.
